name: SCU High Achiever Scholarship
summary: $36,000 offered automatically to 2026 school leavers with an ATAR of 85 or more starting a full-time SCU bachelor degree.
who: Starting a full-time bachelor degree at SCU in 2027.
how: No application. Students do not have to apply for merit-based scholarships.
catches: 15 scholarships, with preference for students from Northern NSW to South East Queensland.
Can't be combined with another merit-based scholarship.

source.label: Southern Cross University: High Achiever Scholarship

evidence.quote: Have achieved an ATAR of 85 and above.
Students do not have to apply for Merit-based Scholarships.
